name: social-bluesky
description: Bluesky for the Social plugin — the worked example of a provider plugin: one manifest block (capabilities.social) and one module, no tools or hooks of its own. Handle + app password; posts with images, mentions and replies, delete, follower numbers.
author: sapphire

social.label: Bluesky

config_schema.label: App password
config_schema.help: bsky.app → Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords. Never your account password.

config_schema.label: Server
config_schema.help: Leave as is unless you run your own PDS.

social.notes: No approval, no fees. Say it is a bot in the profile bio; interact only with people who talk to you.
